preconditions.description: t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(n.is_integer() and 1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: Each test case's n is an integer between 1 and 2*10^5 inclusive, representing the array length.

preconditions.expression: all(all(a_i.is_integer() and 1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: Each array element a_i is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().split() == [str(max(max_score(a) for a in test_cases))) for test_cases in parse_input(stdin))]
postconditions.description: For each test case, output the maximum score achievable by starting at any index in the array, where max_score(a) computes the maximum sum of a_i values along the path starting at each index i (1-based) and moving right by a_i positions until exceeding the array bounds.
